title: Best practices for Multi-Company ERPNext Setup in Garment

posts.name: Shangudresses Shangu
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone,

​I am the owner of a leading garment manufacturing group in Bangladesh, currently operating multiple industrial units. We are planning to implement ERPNext to centralize and manage our end-to-end operations.

​As I am new to this forum, I would appreciate your expert guidance on the following:

  1. ​Stable Multi-Unit Installation: What is the most reliable way to install and host ERPNext for a multi-company environment with centralized control?

  2. ​Apparel-Specific Customizations: We need to integrate industry-specific features like IE (SMV/GSD) bulletins, Piece-rate Payroll, and IoT-based real-time production tracking.

  3. ​Advanced Modules: We are also interested in developing a ‘Fair Shop’ E-commerce portal for our employees with credit limit controls and local AI agents for data analysis.

​How can I find specialized partners or developers who have experience in complex RMG (Ready-Made Garments) manufacturing workflows?

​Looking forward to your suggestions and best practices.

​Best regards,

Arif

posts.name: Asief Tejani
posts.cooked:
@shangudresses-shangu
Welcome to the community

My quick suggestions: -

  1. Check out official frappe partners in Bangladesh - https://frappe.io/partners/list?country=Bangladesh

  2. Join Telegram group (not sure but this one might have companies more than individuals): - Telegram: View @erpnext_opps

  3. If your budget is more constricted then you can try individual freelancers (more risky IMHO): - Telegram: View @erpnextfreelancers

  4. Wait for someone to hopefully answer here in time

Best of luck in your implementation

posts.name: Shangudresses Shangu
posts.cooked:
Thank you for the warm welcome and the resources.

​I have already initiated discussions with Invento Software Limited, the sole official Frappe partner in Bangladesh, and those evaluations are currently in progress. However, I remain open to exploring specialized global expertise to address our complex manufacturing requirements.

​I will also join the recommended Telegram groups to further broaden our search. I appreciate your support.
